decisions.reason: Retaining the 0-ohm I2C series resistors does not change the interboard signal connector selection or pinout.
The I2C series-resistor decision does not affect the separate interboard power connector or its pin-order rule.
The source decision concerns I2C series resistors and does not alter the USB D+ and D- programming interface.
Retaining existing I2C series resistors does not modify the established component-sourceability or alternative-availability policy.
The I2C resistor population decision does not change any ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
